question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

My teacher **__accepted__** my excuse for being late.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Rejected."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Accepted"** means to agree or approve. ((दी गई वस्‍तु को) स्‍वीकार या ग्रहण करना)

 
 
• **Example:** *She **accepted**__ my request.*
 
 
 
• **"Rejected**" means to refuse or deny. (व्‍यकि्त या वस्‍तु को अस्‍वीकार करना (मानने से इनकार करना))
 __
 
• **Example:** *She **rejected**__ my proposal.*
 
 
 
• The context of the sentence suggests that the teacher approved the excuse, so the opposite would be to reject it.
 
• The antonym of **"accepted"** is** "rejected."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Trusted:** to have confidence in someone or something. (किसी पर विश्‍वास या भरोसा करना (उसके भला, ईमानदार आदि होने के विषय में निश्चित होना))
 
• **Agreed: **to come to a mutual understanding or decision. (किसी बात या व्‍यक्ति से सहमत होना; एकमत होना)
 
• **Believed: **to have faith or trust in something or someone. (विश्‍वास करना, सही मान लेना)
